@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+import pytest
+
+import click
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["full", "arguments", "options"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("show_default", [False, True])
+def test_help_record_dispatch(mode, show_default):
+    events = []
+
+    def default():
+        raise AssertionError("Help must not evaluate callable defaults")
+
+    class RecordingOption(click.Option):
+        def get_help_record(self, ctx):
+            events.append(self.name)
+            if self.name == "omit_option":
+                return None
+            return super().get_help_record(ctx)
+
+    class RecordingArgument(click.Argument):
+        def get_help_record(self, ctx):
+            events.append(self.name)
+            if self.name == "omit_arg":
+                return None
+            return self.human_readable_name, f"argument-{self.name}"
+
+    params = [
+        RecordingOption(
+            ["--zulu"], help="option-zulu", default=default, show_default=show_default
+        ),
+        RecordingArgument(["zebra"]),
+        RecordingOption(["--hidden"], hidden=True),
+        RecordingArgument(["omit_arg"]),
+        RecordingOption(["--omit-option"]),
+        RecordingArgument(["alpha"]),
+        RecordingOption(["--alpha-option"], help="option-alpha"),
+    ]
+    cmd = click.Command("demo", params=params)
+    ctx = click.Context(cmd, info_name="demo", terminal_width=80)
+    expected_args = ["zebra", "omit_arg", "alpha"]
+    expected_opts = ["zulu", "hidden", "omit_option", "alpha_option"]
+    expected = {
+        "full": expected_args + expected_opts,
+        "arguments": expected_args,
+        "options": expected_opts,
+    }[mode]
+
+    for render in range(2):
+        if mode == "full":
+            output = cmd.get_help(ctx)
+        else:
+            formatter = ctx.make_formatter()
+            getattr(cmd, f"format_{mode}")(ctx, formatter)
+            output = formatter.getvalue()
+
+        assert events == expected * (render + 1)
+        if mode != "options":
+            assert output.count("Positional arguments:") == 1
+            assert output.count("argument-zebra") == 1
+            assert output.count("argument-alpha") == 1
+            assert output.index("argument-zebra") < output.index("argument-alpha")
+        else:
+            assert "Positional arguments:" not in output
+        if mode != "arguments":
+            assert output.count("Options:") == 1
+            assert output.count("option-zulu") == 1
+            assert output.count("option-alpha") == 1
+            assert output.index("option-zulu") < output.index("option-alpha")
+            assert "--help" in output
+            if show_default:
+                assert "default: (dynamic)" in output
+        else:
+            assert "Options:" not in output
+        if mode == "full":
+            assert output.index("Positional arguments:") < output.index("Options:")
+        for absent in ("--hidden", "--omit-option", "argument-omit_arg"):
+            assert absent not in output
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["arguments", "options"])
+def test_no_records_leave_section_empty(mode):
+    events = []
+
+    class EmptyOption(click.Option):
+        def get_help_record(self, ctx):
+            events.append("option")
+            return None
+
+    class EmptyArgument(click.Argument):
+        def get_help_record(self, ctx):
+            events.append("argument")
+            return None
+
+    cmd = click.Command(
+        "demo",
+        params=[EmptyOption(["--value"]), EmptyArgument(["item"])],
+        add_help_option=False,
+    )
+    ctx = click.Context(cmd, info_name="demo")
+    formatter = ctx.make_formatter()
+    getattr(cmd, f"format_{mode}")(ctx, formatter)
+    assert events == ["argument" if mode == "arguments" else "option"]
+    assert formatter.getvalue() == ""

spec.question: Custom Option and Argument subclasses can perform observable work in get_help_record, but rendering command help currently invokes these hooks more than once. Make Command.get_help request each parameter's help record exactly once per render, during its own section. Calling format_arguments or format_options independently must request records only for that section, once per call; subsequent renders must request fresh records rather than reuse cached results. Preserve positional arguments before options, declaration order within each section, automatic help output, hidden-option behavior, and omission of records returning None. Hidden options must still receive their one option-section hook call, leaving visibility to the hook. Custom argument records must work even when the argument has no help attribute value. Callable defaults must remain unevaluated during help rendering, whether show_default is enabled or disabled. Deliver a unified diff against production files only, leaving tests unchanged.
